mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening economic activity that depresses corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (defined by GDPC1 > 11000 billion dollars), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive 20-day forward returns due to strong economic momentum and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 > 11000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as labor market weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 202.0 indicates accelerating inflation that signals robust economic activity and corporate pricing power, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 202.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recovery (defined by INDPRO > 110.0), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive 5-day forward returns as manufacturing activity picks up and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO > 110.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 1-year rolling window.
